workarounds.symptom: Realtime create() reuses the initial custom URL during automatic reconnects
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(realtime): refresh factory URLs for each connection attempt. Target files: src/realtime/websocket.ts, src/realtime/ws.ts, tests/realtime-wire-lifecycle.test.ts. When a Realtime session created with `.create()` reconnects, it currently reuses the first URL even if a custom URL builder or the client's base URL changes. Both the `ws` and native transports now build one fresh URL per connection attempt. Custom builders keep their original options object and method receiver. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-node/pull/2982)

workarounds.symptom: test: Azure example fixtures cannot resolve dotenv through the Windows Bash runner
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(test): preserve compiled example workspace dependencies. Target files: scripts/setup-test-fixtures.ts, tests/lib/realtime-example-status.test.ts. Compiled examples now resolve their examples workspace dependencies without relying on the shell's NODE_PATH. The fixture links each installed package by its real path, which avoids nesting pnpm's relative links inside a Windows junction. The existing tests clear NODE_PATH and include child stderr in connection failures. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-node/pull/2983)

workarounds.symptom: SSE stream drops the final event (finish_reason / response.completed lost) when the server omits the trailing blank line
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(streaming): emit terminal SSE events missing a trailing blank line. Target files: src/core/streaming.ts, tests/lib/streaming-core.test.ts. - `SSEDecoder` previously emitted only on a blank line. `iterSSEChunks` already yields leftover bytes at EOF and `LineDecoder` is flushed, but the SSE decoder was never flushed, so a final `data:` / `event:` record without `\n\n` was discarded. - Flush the pending SSE event at EOF so `finish_reason` / `response.completed` are delivered when a gateway closes the stream immediately a... (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-node/pull/2726)

workarounds.symptom: Non-streaming chat runners drop caller abort reasons
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: preserve chat runner abort reasons. Target files: src/lib/AbstractChatCompletionRunner.ts, src/lib/AssistantStream.ts, src/lib/ChatCompletionStream.ts. Preserve caller-provided abort reasons across chat completion convenience runners. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-node/pull/2607)

workarounds.symptom: Abort during retry backoff waits for the full delay
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(client): interrupt retry backoff on abort. Target files: src/client.ts, src/internal/parse.ts, src/internal/utils/sleep.ts. Aborting any SDK request during `Retry-After` backoff still waited for the full delay. In the live 3-second case, both caller signals and signals installed by `prepareRequest` took about 2.9 seconds to stop. (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-node/pull/2581)

workarounds.symptom: Audit CI coverage: main-only examples failures should block releases
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: support Jest 28 CommonJS package imports. Target files: ecosystem-tests/cli.ts, ecosystem-tests/node-ts-cjs-auto/tests/import.test.ts, ecosystem-tests/node-ts-cjs-web/tests/import.test.ts. After #2507 fixes the CommonJS + browser-condition Jest failure, the main-only examples job still has two CommonJS fixtures that fail under Jest 28: (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-node/pull/2511)

workarounds.symptom: ChatCompletionStream/ResponseStream: mid-stream errors are silently swallowed when iterating with `for await`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(streaming): surface mid-stream errors when iterating buffered streams. Target files: src/lib/AssistantStream.ts, src/lib/ChatCompletionStream.ts, src/lib/ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.ts. Streaming consumers could silently treat a failed request as successful when chunks or events were already buffered before a terminal error arrived. Chat Completions, Assistants, and streaming tool-runner readable-stream bridges each retained their own lossy iterator implementation; Responses streaming now also uses the same shared i... (Ref: https://github.com/openai/openai-node/pull/2047)
